docstring:
Every tree admits a graceful labeling.

A graceful labeling of a tree $T$ with $m$ edges is an injective map $f : V \to \{0, \dots, m\}$
such that the multiset of absolute differences $|f(u) - f(v)|$ over edges $\{u,v\}$ of $T$
equals $\{1, \dots, m\}$.
type_pretty:
∀ {V : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] (T : SimpleGraph V) [inst_2 : DecidableRel T.Adj],
  T.IsTree →
    have m := T.edgeFinset.card;
    ∃ f,
      Function.Injective f ∧
        (∀ (v : V), f v ≤ m) ∧
          Finset.image (fun e => Sym2.lift ⟨fun u v => (↑(f u) - ↑(f v)).natAbs, ⋯⟩ e) T.edgeFinset = Finset.Icc 1 m
